title: AutoRNet: Automatically Optimizing Heuristics for Robust Network Design via Large Language Models

live_model.evidence: "The GPT-4 Turbo model was used with a temperature setting of 1" (Sec. 5.1); Table 1, Heuristic-v3 achieves an average robustness of 0.307550 for 200-node networks, outperforming all baseline algorithms

prompt.location: Appendix A (population-initialization task specification, describing but not fully quoting the prompt; references Figure A1), Appendix C (variation-operation prompt)
prompt.note: GPT-4 Turbo proposes Python heuristic code inside an evolutionary loop (population 10, 50 generations); the reported R values come from executing the resulting deterministic code, not from further live-model calls at evaluation time.

claim.metric: Network robustness R, best discovered heuristic (Heuristic-v3), 200-node BA test networks
claim.location: Table 1 (R obtained on networks of different sizes); 100 independent test runs of the fixed generated heuristic

data.source: Synthetic BA scale-free networks plus a real-world EU power grid network (cited, ref. [31]); heuristic-design prompts summarized but not fully reprinted

notes: Reproducing the exact R value requires re-running a stochastic LLM-driven evolutionary search (temperature 1) to design a comparable heuristic, not a single deterministic prompt/response -- treated as the soft gap for 'maybe'. Design-phase cost (~500 calls: 10 population x 50 generations) is separate from the cost-free test-time execution of the resulting code.
